target: External pilot for the fixed rat-trained Next Neuron Prediction model on concurrently recorded turtle dorsal-cortex spike clusters, if the source supports a population. No model fitting or threshold changes on turtle outcomes.
source: Shein-Idelson, Becker and Leberstein, View invariant representations in ancestral cortex. Dryad 10.5061/dryad.k98sf7mm6, version 406647, CC0. Author repository EvolutionaryNeuralCodingLab/SpatiallySelectiveViewInvariance, tag v1.0.0, commit b421ce0a62140a812e964cb027b97f979e98f049. Select spikes.mat and the original plot_Fig1h.m. Source plot uses cluster identity, spike timestamp in milliseconds, and a common vector of stimulus onsets. Do not select cells by the published response significance statistic.
rule: Sort the underlying stimulus onsets back into chronological order; select the first 40 complete, nonoverlapping 3-second trial windows that fit within reported event-clock coverage, with boundaries from 500 ms before to 2500 ms after the stimulus. If there are fewer than 40, report the number available and keep the first 20 for roster initialization. Use the first 20 qualified trials only to discover the available cluster IDs. The next up to 20 original trials form the evaluation set. Reinitialize all model state at each test trial. Keep every eligible observed cluster; if a new cluster appears during a test trial, censor that trial at its first out-of-roster event and explicitly count the affected windows. Never obtain the candidate vocabulary or a weight from held outcomes. No common voltage amplitudes, electrode coordinates or cluster labels are assumed across animals.
clock_and_controls: Convert native milliseconds to seconds. Use the existing corrected 1 ms model in its fixed form. Predict after each completed occupied millisecond. Score the next occupied bin only if it contains one event; retain unresolved ties and edge truncations. Compare training-independent uniform, within-trial cumulative counts and recency with the fixed five coefficients. Reuse benchmark score code, reporting pooled and equal-trial/target-unit results and first 10 occupied bins. No claims about unrecorded cells or about other reptiles. Source covers one figure recording, without a population sampling guarantee.
failure: If the sample supplies only one cluster, incompatible clocks, or insufficient verified simultaneous sorted units, withhold a comparative unit-identity score. Document the source and use its field signal only as a distinct named measurement in the source register.
selection_context: Design fixed after reading the authors' metadata and raster plotting code but before opening numeric contents of spikes.mat.
